characterization_methods: in situ transmission Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR)
evidence: Using in situ transmission Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR), formate is detected after ozone exposure (second part of the TMA/O3 ALD cycle), resulting from the further oxidation of surface methoxy groups. To support the observed IR band assignments, vibrational calculations using the density functional theory (DFT) code DMol3 are carried out... The vibrational modes associated with O3 ALD surface structures are calculated using fully periodic Al2O3 surface models, as well as simple cluster models, for comparison with experimental data.
